My company uses them. Their MDM and SSO is actually not that bad, and it's much cheaper than jamf. Buttt... Their support sucks, and their integration engineer was quite useless, and I had to figure almost everything out myself.
We have recently switched to JumpCloud and have been very happy. The biggest selling point for us has been their ability to support Mac, Windows, and Linux with a single pane of glass.

They automatically rotated API keys, which I presume was how the attackers were accessing the platform and recommended rotating all SSO certs. Having a vulnerability that led to command runner access is not a great look but they've handled the aftermath very well.
